label.spicy: Spend 20 minutes finding a previous version of this task, attempt the first step, then message them one specific question
label.boardroom: Spend 20 minutes locating a previous example, attempt the first step, then send one specific question

consequence.spicy: You arrive at tomorrow with progress and a precise question. That combination is more or less unarguable.
consequence.boardroom: You arrive at the following day with progress and a precise question — a strong position.

label.spicy: Ask the team channel if anyone knows what this is
label.boardroom: Ask the team channel whether anyone can clarify it

consequence.spicy: Often works. Costs you nothing except the version of this where you found it yourself in nine minutes.
consequence.boardroom: Frequently effective, though it forgoes the possibility of resolving it independently.

label.spicy: Reply "sure, will pick this up" and wait for them to be back to explain it
label.boardroom: Acknowledge it and wait for their return to clarify

consequence.spicy: You've now confirmed you're on it and done none of it. A day of that is survivable. A habit of it is a reputation.
consequence.boardroom: You have confirmed ownership without progress. Occasional is manageable; habitual becomes a reputation.

label.spicy: Work on something else and hope it clarifies itself
label.boardroom: Focus elsewhere and wait for it to become clearer

consequence.spicy: It does not clarify itself. It gains a day of age and becomes slightly harder to ask about.
consequence.boardroom: It will not clarify itself, and becomes progressively harder to raise.

verdict.spicy: Nothing to score yet. XP is for answering honestly, not for being right — we'll come back to this.
verdict.boardroom: No assessment yet. Credit is awarded for answering, not for being correct. This will be revisited.

principle.spicy: Remember what you picked. You'll have opinions about it in forty minutes.
